mk2.name: ELECTRIC MINER MK2
mk2.subtitle: Krastorio 2 / 四向电动矿机
mk2.notes: Dry source geometry and 195-step drill/shadow sequence. util.by_pixel offsets become tiles by /32; .5 source scale applies to dimensions, not again to shifts. Waypoint stop/transition durations are converted from 60 ticks/s. Status LED uses local green additive display; resource dust uses a local iron tint. Stop freezes current pose immediately, disables dust/light; no original simulation or water overlay.

core.name: CORE EXTRACTOR
core.subtitle: Hurricane / 核心采掘设施
core.notes: Source 11x11 selection box, 704px body at .5 scale, 120 frames at speed .5 (30fps). Second stripe declares a maximum 8x8 grid; final source sheet holds 56 valid frames. Shadow has no shift. Preview stop holds frame and immediately disables working emission.
